title: ADWEEK and NewtonX Launch B2B Brand Tracker
summary: ADWEEK and NewtonX launched a quarterly B2B Brand Tracker surveying 500 advertising decision-makers across the U.S. and Canada to measure long-term industry trends and real-time shifts including CMO expectations, growth strategies, and AI-driven operating models.
whyItMatters: A productized recurring research tracker is a stronger commercial signal than one-off thought leadership, demonstrating NewtonX's move toward subscription-style research products.
